issues.description: Method visibility contradiction for helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the UML in the problem statement declares singFarmSongVerse as private (UML member marked with '-') while the Part 3 textual instructions explicitly request the helper method to be public for easier testing. Both the provided template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the reference solution implement singFarmSongVerse as private. This inconsistency (UML vs. textual instruction vs. template/solution) can confuse students about the expected visibility and may cause tests or grading code that expect a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility contradiction by making all artifacts consistent. Two viable options: (A) Keep the method private: update the Part 3 textual instruction to remove or change the sentence asking for a public helper and update the UML to show the method as private, or (B) Make the helper public: change the method signature in the template and solution to public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)), and update the UML to show it as public and remove the contradictory phrase. If automated tests require public access for direct invocation, prefer option B and update the template, solution, and UML accordingly.
